recent_moves: Jan-2025 — acquired by Hindustan Unilever, 90.5% at Rs2,955cr pre-money (~US$350mn), ~8.5x FY24 revenue
read: The benchmark exit in Indian derma D2C and the most useful single valuation reference in this repo: Rs347cr FY24 revenue, +89% off Rs184cr, profitable at Rs10.83cr PAT, sold to HUL at Rs2,955cr for 90.5% — about 8.5x trailing revenue. Two things follow for an entrant. First, the masstige derma tier is where Indian buyers are paying up, consistent with the 14.6% CAGR forecast on masstige derma cosmetics (Expert Market Research, LOW). Second, growing profitably at that rate mattered to the price: this was not a loss-making land-grab exit, which sets a harder bar for anyone planning to buy scale in the same segment now that the fastest asset is inside HUL.
